description: Use this when the host asks who is on an interview, who has been invited, has started or has finished, or when get_results needs a participant's id. Do not use it for meetings held on another service, for another account's interviews, or to score, rank or reject participants: Tracy only reports what they said. It returns the people on an interview, newest first, with each one's status (Held, Invited, Opened, Started, Completed, Expired), email status, how many sessions they have had, and their personal link. A participant's id identifies their results in get_results.

interview_id.description: The interview's id, exactly as list_interviews or create_interview returned it in its structured data. It is for tool calls only: never show it to the host; name the interview by its title. Do not guess an id, and do not send a title or an email address in its place: if you do not have the id, call list_interviews.
